participant_id.Description: Participant specific identification number (sub, sub_id) in BIDS format, e.g.: sub-0001

id.Description: numeric variant of the participant specific identification number

task.Description: string that indicates the task the individual trial belongs to

cohort.Description: first (vmp1) or second (vmp2) data collection cohort of the Visceral Mind Project

weight.Description: What do you weigh in kilos?

height.Description: How tall are you in cm?

handedness.Description: Are you right or left handed?

head_size.Description: Do you know the circumfrence of your head or can you measure it?

circumfrence_head.Description: What is the circumfrence of your head in cm?

hat_size.Description: What size would you estimate your head to be in hat-size?
